SELECT
    p1.ProductKey AS product_1_key,
    p1.ProductName AS product_1_name,
    p2.ProductKey AS product_2_key,
    p2.ProductName AS product_2_name,
    count() AS orders_together
FROM
(
    SELECT DISTINCT SalesOrderNumber, ProductKey
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
) AS a
INNER JOIN
(
    SELECT DISTINCT SalesOrderNumber, ProductKey
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
) AS b
    ON a.SalesOrderNumber = b.SalesOrderNumber
   AND a.ProductKey < b.ProductKey
INNER JOIN retail.DimProduct AS p1
    ON a.ProductKey = p1.ProductKey
INNER JOIN retail.DimProduct AS p2
    ON b.ProductKey = p2.ProductKey
GROUP BY
    p1.ProductKey,
    p1.ProductName,
    p2.ProductKey,
    p2.ProductName
ORDER BY orders_together DESC
LIMIT 10
